issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff only changes the acceptance rule in the local search loop. It reads no files, pastes no coordinates and makes no network calls, and the seeded RandomState(7) is kept. The final result still goes through _make_valid.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The Metropolis rule is replaced by a threshold rule that compares against the best score so far (record-to-record travel), with a margin D that shrinks to 0 by the 215 s deadline and a jump back to the best packing after 40 bad steps in a row. The variable T is now unused, which is harmless. span is guarded against zero. best_* is still updated only on a strict improvement. The job still runs about 215 s plus setup, which should fit under the 4-minute margin if the incumbent did.
The loop still reads the clock, so the run is not exactly repeatable even with the seed. This is the same as the incumbent and does not affect validity.

The numbers match the stated decision. Candidate -2.636 against incumbent -2.6360, one run each, gives a difference of 0, so z = 0 and reject is consistent. With n=1 on each side the variance cannot be estimated, so z rests only on the zero difference. The sum of about 2.636 is in line with the best known value (about 2.6359 before rounding), so it is not suspicious.
